worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.summary: Fire two thin beams from the left and right signal sources on the body, crossing at the aim point: each beam is clipped by real walls and settles only half damage on its own, so a target caught by both at the crossing takes the full amount. A hit may jam the target into confusion, making it fumble. Aim near to cross and spread to both sides; aim far to keep the two beams wide apart up front.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.use.0: Pin several enemies lined up in one sweep
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.use.1: Control the spread with near or far focus distance
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.use.2: Converge both beams on one target for full damage
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.description: Fires one thin beam from each of the left and right emitters, each clipped by real walls; a single beam settles at most once per enemy for about half of the %1$s full power, and overlapping both beams deals the full amount. Up to %4$s enemies are hit in total; each beam is %3$s blocks long and the emitters are %2$s blocks apart.
On hit, a %1$s chance jams the target into confusion for %2$s s; while jammed, each action it starts has a %3$s chance to be broken.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.pulse.on: Pulse: the emitters draw closer, each beam is heavier and the jam chance higher, at the cost of shorter reach - good for singling one target out.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.pulse.off: Continuous: the emitters sit wider and the beams reach farther, at the cost of a lighter beam and a lower jam chance.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the full power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.signalbeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the full power rises to %2$s and the jam chance to %3$s.
On: the emitters draw closer, each beam x1.15 and jam chance x1.3, but x0.88 reach - good for one target. Off (Continuous): the emitters sit wider and the beams reach farther, at the cost of a lighter beam and a lower jam chance.
Beyond this distance it closes in first; higher means it fires earlier. It will not fire when a wall blocks the line.

On: a target with other enemies around it ranks higher, and the crossing is pulled slightly forward so the two beams cross before the group and sweep both sides; a lone target is still crossed on its body for full damage. Off: normal ranged-attack ordering.
On: lower-health targets rank higher for the finishing hit; off: all targets rank alike.
